newsitem.title: TAJIKISTAN: Tajik leader to meet rebel colonel - official.
newsitem.headline: Tajik leader to meet rebel colonel - official.

text.p: Tajik President Imomali Rakhmonov will hold peace talks on Wednesday with mutinous colonel Makhmud Khudoyberdyev, a presidential spokesman said.

"In the next few hours, a meeting will take place between Rakhmonov and (Makhmud) Khudoyberdyev but the time and place are secret," Zafar Saidov, Rakhmonov's press secretary, told Reuters by telephone in the capital Dushanbe.
